rationale: Hebrews 11:4 names Abel directly and supplies "faith" as the reason his offering was accepted -- "By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did" -- a specific causal claim Genesis 4:4-5 itself does not make; the Genesis text reports only that "the LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering, but He had no regard for Cain and his offering" (4:4-5), without using the vocabulary of faith. The naming is direct and the causal claim explicit, which is why the type is explicit_reference and the label is explicit; this row reports Hebrews' own stated reason, not an inference drawn from Genesis 4's wording alone.
